shortDescription: Provision, Reset, or Update CloudVision Portal Devices.

options.name: configlet_mode
options.description: If override, Add listed configlets and remove all unlisted ones. If merge, Add listed configlets to device and do not touch already configured configlets.

options.name: cvp_facts
options.description: Facts from CVP collected by cv_facts module.

options.name: device_filter
options.description: Filter to apply intended mode on a set of configlet. If not used, then module only uses ADD mode. device_filter list devices that can be modified or deleted based on configlets entries.

options.name: devices
options.description: Yaml dictionary to describe intended devices configuration from CVP stand point.

options.name: options
options.description: Implements the ability to create a sub-argument_spec, where the sub options of the top level argument are also validated using the attributes discussed in this section.

options.name: state
options.description: If absent, devices will be removed from CVP and moved back to undefined. If present, devices will be configured or updated.
